title: Starlink Black Friday 2026: what the Nevada offer costs
seoTitle: Starlink Black Friday 2026: 30% off service in select areas
description: On the order page for Reno, Nevada, Starlink showed $21.65 due today and plans from $38.50 a month. See how the referral reward fits in and how to check your address.
metaDescription: In Reno, Starlink showed 30% off service, a $0 rental kit and plans from $38.50 a month. See what the order costs and check your own address.
imageAlt: A white Starlink dish on a roof under a starry sky. The cover asks what the Black Friday offers cost.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: A Reno, Nevada, order showed 30% off service plans, a $0 rental kit and $21.65 due at checkout. Plans started at $38.50 a month. The order shown with our link listed a separate $100 referral reward. Check your address for the offer and confirm the reward rules before paying.

contentSections.heading: What you pay and when the reward lands
paragraphs: We read the order page for Reno, Nevada, on November 20, 2026, without completing a purchase. It showed $21.65 due today. Residential 100 Mbps was listed at $38.50 a month, with the Starlink V5 and Router Mini included, and Max at $91 a month. The hardware was a rental, $0 upfront and $0 a month.

The screenshot with our link showed $20 plus taxes due at checkout and a $100 referral offer. Two months at the price displayed for 100 Mbps would be $77. Check your actual bills and any upfront charges before calculating how much of that cost an eligible reward would cover.

rows: Referral reward on the Nevada order with our link, after two monthly cycles
comparisonTable.caption: Values as shown on the order page. We did not record how long the promotional price lasts or what the plan costs afterward.

postParagraphs: To get the reward, the referral has to be eligible and the service has to stay active and paid up for two full monthly cycles. Starlink offers credit on the invoice and, depending on the account, payment in cash.

contentSections.heading: What the order looks like
paragraphs: The screenshot shows “Referral Code Applied” and a displayed offer of $100 each for the new customer and the referrer. Starlink checks eligibility before the reward is paid.
To check your own offer, open the link, enter your address and look for the same notice before you pay. See whether the order shows the reward and the monthly price.

image.alt: Order screen on the official Starlink site with the message Referral Code Applied, saying that by signing up with this code you and your friend get $100 each, as cash or service credit
image.caption: Order on the official site with the referral link applied (Nevada).

contentSections.heading: What is it worth to refer someone?
paragraphs: After you subscribe you can refer other people, and the person who refers gets the same amount, in cash or as service credit. The person you refer has to complete the required cycles before the reward is paid.
See [how the referral program works](/en/reviews/starlink-referral-link-how-it-works) and check in your account what each referral is worth.

contentSections.heading: Does the offer apply at your address?
paragraphs: The 30% applies in select areas and depends on the address you enter. Put in yours and compare the monthly price, the kit, the installation and how long the promotion runs. The order page for Reno said the kit ships within one week.

contentSections.heading: Rental kit, cancelling and the refund
paragraphs: The Nevada order says rented equipment must be returned if you cancel. Its refund terms describe canceling service and returning the kit undamaged within 30 days of the payment due date. See the [contract, cancellation and refund guide](/en/reviews/starlink-contract-cancel-refund).

contentSections.heading: What comes after the promotion?
paragraphs: We did not read the plan price once the promotional period ends. Before you pay, check the order page for how long the 30% runs and what the standard price is.

contentSections.heading: How to use the link
paragraphs: Open the link and type the address where you will install the dish. Pick the plan, check that the referral shows as applied and save a screenshot of the offer before you pay.
The [Starlink referral page](/en/coupons/starlink) has the link and the program rules.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Starlink have a Black Friday deal? The order page we read shows 30% off service plans in select areas for those who sign up before the end of the month, with a $0 rental kit.

Does the referral stack with the offer? The plan offer and the referral are separate lines on the order. The Nevada order with our link showed the $100 referral next to a total due of $20 plus taxes. The reward depends on eligibility and two full monthly cycles.
How much do you pay when you order? The Reno order page showed $21.65 due today. The first monthly bill follows after that.
Is the Starlink kit free? The page lists it as a rental with $0 upfront and $0 a month. If you cancel, you have to return it.
How long does the offer run? Starlink advertises it until the end of November. Enter your address on the order page to see whether it is available.

cta.text: The order opens on the Starlink site. Check the plan price, the kit terms and the referral value before you pay.
